第48章 烂怂大雁塔-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

当天下午，横店影视城。

黑色的大众缓缓停下，车门拉开，魏沐迈步下车，站在了这片熟悉的土地上。

他深吸一口空气，还是那个熟悉的味道。

这并不是他第一次来横店，上辈子做演员在这里待了好几年。

可不管来多少次，横店总能给他一种奇特的时空错乱感。

眼前是古香古色的建筑，耳边听到的却是游客嘈杂的现代喧哗。

身边不时掠过穿着T恤短裤的路人和一身古装、正拿着手机打电话的群演。

这种感觉，只有影视城才能给他。

“沐哥，我们先回酒店吗？”

刚从车上下来的助理小刘，询问接下来的计划。

她是第一次来横店，好奇的眼睛到处瞟，看什么都觉得新鲜。

这次过来探班秦兰，魏沐带了三个人，除了小刘，还有两个跑腿的助理。

“嗯，先回酒店，然后你去安排他们两个准备探班礼物。”

“好嘞。我知道。”

第一次过来探班好姐姐，不能空手而来。

下塌酒店距离明清宫苑影视基地不远，这里是电视剧《黑三角》最后的拍摄地点。

此前，该剧组已经辗转多个取景地，从松花江畔到东鸡冠山北堡垒，最后再到横店。

在记忆里搜寻一圈，上辈子他似乎既没看过《黑三角》，甚至连听都很少听说。

这就是大部分横店剧组的归宿。

横店每年接待的剧组数量非常庞大，并且一年比一年多，巅峰时期多达2300个。

没什么用！！

最终能挤上电视台播出的，十不存一。

《黑三角》的女主角是秦兰，男主则是海波。

海波.....

熟悉又陌生的名字，这哥们目前在上升期，距离得罪人还有几年。

来到酒店办理入住登记，助理小刘给他收拾房间。

“沐哥，横店这地方可真有意思！”，小刘一边归置东西，一边忍不住感叹。

“我以前都没来过，刚才在车上，看到好几个眼熟的明星呢”

有啥好玩的，他都看腻了，来来去去就是那些人。

这就和大雁塔一样，外地人看着稀奇，本地人表示“烂怂大雁塔有啥看头！！”

不过看着小助理跃跃欲试的样子，魏沐没有阻拦：“等探班结束，我给你放一天假，随便去哪玩，我给你报销。”

“嘿嘿，谢谢沐哥。”

小姑娘一听，眼睛瞬间弯成了月牙。

.........

That afternoon, Hengdian Film and Television City.

The black Volkswagen stopped slowly, opened the door, and Wei Mu stepped out of the car, standing on this familiar land.

He took a deep breath of air, and it still had that familiar smell.

This is not his first time coming to Hengdian. He spent several years here as an actor in his previous life.

But no matter how many times he came, Hengdian always gave him a strange sense of time and space.

There are ancient buildings in front of you, but what you hear in your ears are the noisy modern noises of tourists.

From time to time, passers-by wearing T-shirts and shorts and extras in ancient costumes were making calls on their mobile phones.

This feeling can only be given to him by the film and television city.

"Brother Mu, shall we go back to the hotel first?"

Assistant Xiao Liu, who had just gotten off the car, asked about the next plan.

It was her first time to come to Hengdian. She looked around with curious eyes, and everything she saw seemed new.

This time when he came to visit Qin Lan, Wei Mu brought three people. In addition to Xiao Liu, there were also two assistants who were running errands.

"Well, go back to the hotel first, and then you can arrange for the two of them to prepare gifts for the visit."

"Okay. I know."

This is my first time to visit my dear sister, so I can’t come empty-handed.

The Xiataan Hotel is not far from the Ming and Qing Palace Film and Television Base, which was the final filming location for the TV series "The Black Triangle".

Previously, the crew had traveled to multiple filming locations, from the banks of the Songhua River to the North Fortress of East Jiguan Mountain, and finally to Hengdian.

Searching around in his memory, it seemed that he had never seen "The Black Triangle" in his previous life, and had rarely even heard of it.

This is where most of the Hengdian crew ended up.

Hengdian receives a very large number of crews every year, and the number is increasing year by year, with as many as 2,300 at its peak.

It’s of no use!!

Only one out of ten can be broadcast on a TV station in the end.

The heroine of "Black Triangle" is Qin Lan, and the male protagonist is Hai Bo.

Haibo.....

A familiar yet unfamiliar name, this guy is currently on the rise and is still a few years away from offending anyone.

When he came to the hotel to check in, his assistant Xiao Liu cleaned up the room for him.

"Brother Mu, Hengdian is such an interesting place!" Xiao Liu couldn't help but sigh while putting things away.

"I've never been here before. I saw several familiar celebrities in the car just now."

He was tired of seeing anything interesting, just those people coming and going.

This is just like the Big Wild Goose Pagoda. Outsiders look at it strangely, and the locals say, "What's the point of the Big Wild Goose Pagoda!!"

However, seeing the assistant's eagerness to try, Wei Mu did not stop him: "When the visit is over, I will give you a day off. You can go wherever you like and I will reimburse you."

"Hey, thank you, Brother Mu."

When the little girl heard this, her eyes instantly turned into crescent moons.
